    # Four vertical beams at x=5.45, 5.90, 6.35, 6.75, each 0.08m wide and 0.08m high
    beam1 = sandbox.add_static_beam(x=5.45, y=1.92, width=0.08, height=0.08, angle=0, density=200.0)
    beam2 = sandbox.add_static_beam(x=5.90, y=1.92, width=0.08, height=0.08, angle=0, density=200.0)
    beam3 = sandbox.add_static_beam(x=6.35, y=1.92, width=0.08, height=0.08, angle=0, density=200.0)
    beam4 = sandbox.add_static_beam(x=6.75, y=1.92, width=0.08, height=0.08, angle=0, density=200.0)
    
    # Upper barrier (medium-large) at y=2.45
    # Two vertical beams at x=5.45 and 5.90, each 0.08m wide and 0.08m high
    beam5 = sandbox.add_static_beam(x=5.45, y=2.45, width=0.08, height=0.08, angle=0, density=200.0)
    beam6 = sandbox.add_static_beam(x=5.90, y=2.45, width=0.08, height=0.08, angle=0, density=200.0)
    
    # Connect all beams to the ground
    for beam in [beam1, beam2, beam3, beam4, beam5, beam6]:
        # Anchor at the bottom center of the beam
        anchor_x = beam.position.x
        anchor_y = beam.position.y - beam.height / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(beam, None, (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    
    return beam1
